DOI metadata check

Paste up to 200 DOIs. Each record is read from the public Crossref REST API in your browser, one at a time, and checked for common gaps: authors, ORCID iDs, abstract, references, licence, ISBN/ISSN, page range and date. Nothing is stored or sent to us.

    DOITypeTitleContributorsORCIDAbstractRefs LicenceISBN/ISSNPagePublishedFlagsRawAPA

    “MISSING” means the field is absent from the Crossref record, not necessarily an error: front matter has no author, books have no page range. Flags are heuristics. Data: Crossref REST API (metadata CC0); references: doi.org content negotiation (CSL).
